title: Free Video Collage Maker for iPhone, iPad & Mac
lead: Stack videos. Mix photos and clips. Build grids or honeycomb layouts with ByteWave, free on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac.
honeyText: Seven hexagonal cells showing the moon, a dog, and a sunny field.
seasideText: Six seaside clips share one frame, then the edit cuts to a dog playing on the beach.
warpedText: Ocean sunset footage bent into curved, mirrored bands.
hexText: Ocean sunsets and waves arranged in four hexagonal panels over a full-frame sunset background in ByteWave.
feature1: Combine photos and videos in the same layout.
feature2: Stack clips vertically or arrange them side by side.
feature3: Build grids with up to 144 cells.
feature4: Try symmetry and polygon shapes with up to twelve sides.
step2: Choose an arrangement and add your photos and videos.
step3: Adjust the composition, preview it, and export.
pricing: Free on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac. Editing runs locally on your device. No subscription or ByteWave export watermark.
publisher: Published by ByteWave, which makes the app discussed here.
